comment: yoagent's built-in model prices, USD per million tokens, keyed by ModelConfig::provider then ModelConfig::id. A cache rate of 0 (or omitted) bills at the band's input rate. Rates are a snapshot checked against each 'source' on its 'verified' date, not an authority; tests/price_audit.rs diffs every entry against models.dev. See docs/concepts/pricing.md.

claude-fable-5-1.note: Cache hits bill at 0.025x input ($0.25), not Fable 5's 0.1x. cache_write is the 5-minute rate; the 1-hour rate ($20) is not modelled because yoagent places only 5-minute breakpoints. Verified against the raw page markup.

claude-haiku-4-5.note: Flat: the 200K window is below any long-context band.

claude-opus-5-5.note: Cache hits bill at 0.05x input ($0.20), not the usual 0.1x. cache_write is the 5-minute rate; the 1-hour rate ($8) is not modelled because yoagent places only 5-minute breakpoints. Verified against the raw page markup.

claude-sonnet-5.note: Shipped Sonnet 4.6's $3/$15 from v0.9.0 through v0.16.5; these are Sonnet 5's own rates.

muse-spark-1.1.note: Meta charges no cache-write premium, so writes bill at the $1.25 input rate; models.dev omits cache_write for Muse Spark. No long-context premium. The contributor tier (muse-spark-*-contributor) is priced far lower and is deliberately not listed here.

muse-spark-1.2.note: Meta charges no cache-write premium, so writes bill at the $1.25 input rate; models.dev omits cache_write for Muse Spark. No long-context premium. The contributor tier (muse-spark-*-contributor) is priced far lower and is deliberately not listed here.

gpt-5.5.note: The >272K cache_read ($1.00) is UNVERIFIED. The model page says only that "prompts with >272K input tokens are priced at 2x input and 1.5x output for the full session" - it names no cache rate, and the pricing page no longer lists gpt-5.5. $1.00 (2x, as the GPT-6 pages state for their cache rates) matches models.dev; the literal reading would keep $0.50. Input $10 and output $45 are stated. OpenAI charges no cache-write premium before GPT-5.6, so cache writes bill at the input rate ($5, $10 above 272K); models.dev omits cache_write for it.
